beats.on: DonProof FB · DonProof FB-S · DonProof HS
beats.vo: Candidate products: DonProof FB, DonProof FB-S, DonProof HS.

beats.on: Blinding concrete or compacted sand | Geotextile cushion layer | DonProof FB membrane | Structural concrete cast against membrane
beats.vo: Membrane on blinding, over a geotextile cushion; concrete is cast against it.

beats.on: A 20 mm fillet should be formed at the base of the retaining walls, formwork stop ends, and upstands / All overlaps of the membranes should be a minimum of 50 mm and must be detailed by a heat / The ends of the membrane should be staggered by a minimum of 300 mm
beats.vo: Base fillet, minimum overlap, staggered roll ends.

beats.on: Comparison
beats.vo: FB and FB-S report the same tests, so they compare directly.

beats.on: Choose DonProof FB-S when: Can be used both pre- and post-applied. / Choose DonProof HS when: Easy and quick application, no priming or fillets required.
beats.vo: FB-S: pre- or post-applied. HS: no priming or fillets.

beats.on: On roofs, the surface sees rain, sun and foot traffic.
beats.vo: On roofs, the surface sees rain, sun and foot traffic.

beats.on: DonProof PU-P150 · DonProof PU-P100 · DonProof PU-P60
beats.vo: Candidate products: DonProof PU-P150, DonProof PU-P100, DonProof PU-P60.

beats.on: Concrete deck | Primer — DonProof Primer EP | DonProof PU-P150 membrane | DonProof AL aliphatic polyurethane topcoat
beats.vo: Primed deck, hot-sprayed polyurea, then an aliphatic polyurethane topcoat.

beats.on: always apply DonProof PU-P60 perpendicularly to the substrate regardless of whether the surface is horizontal or vertical / a texture “stipple” coat can be applied for non-skid purposes / All 90-degree internal corners shall be strip coated and allowed to gel prior to application of the finish coat
beats.vo: Spray perpendicular to the substrate; strip-coat internal corners.

beats.on: Comparison
beats.vo: All three report tensile, elongation and tear to the same ASTM methods.

beats.on: Choose DonProof PU-P150 when: Under XPS insulation as part of an inverted or / Choose DonProof PU-P60 when: Cold Resistance: down to minus 40ºC.
beats.vo: P150: inverted roofs under XPS. P60: cold resistance to minus forty.

beats.on: DonProof PU-C100 · Aquathane R100 · Aquathane E400
beats.vo: Candidate products: DonProof PU-C100, Aquathane R100, Aquathane E400.

beats.on: Concrete or screed | Primer — DonProof Primer PU | DonProof PU-C100 membrane | Under-tile finish
beats.vo: Primer, membrane in one or two coats, then the tile finish.

beats.on: formed at all corners and normal PVC pipes minimum 1 cm x 1 cm fillet / with a 30 cm strip to be placed over the first coat while still wet / Do not leave more than 24 hours between two coats of Aquathane E400
beats.vo: Corner fillet, reinforcing strip at changes of plane, recoat within 24 hours.

beats.on: Comparison
beats.vo: Bond to concrete is reported to the same ASTM method.

beats.on: Choose DonProof PU-C100 when: Cold applied with a roller, brush, trowel, squeegee or / Choose Aquathane E400 when: Wet areas, kitchens and bathrooms (under tiles).
beats.vo: C100: cold applied by roller, brush, trowel or squeegee. E400: under tiles.

beats.on: Strongcoat EPW-P · Strongcoat EPW-S · Setseal 300C
beats.vo: Candidate products: Strongcoat EPW-P, Strongcoat EPW-S, Setseal 300C.

beats.on: Concrete wall | Strongcoat EPW — two coats
beats.vo: Two coats of Strongcoat EPW on the concrete wall.

beats.on: Apply the second coat of Strongcoat EPW within 24 hours at 25oC or 10 hours at 45oC / Strongcoat EPW should not be applied if the application temperature is expected to drop below 5oC or if the relative humidity will exceed 90% / Application should not be carried out, when there is standing or running water.
beats.vo: Second coat within 24 hours at 25 degrees; never over standing water.

beats.on: Comparison — different test methods
beats.vo: One TDS, two grades: colour and chemical resistance differ.

beats.on: Choose Strongcoat EPW-P when: Strongcoat EPW-P is suitable for use with potable water / Choose Strongcoat EPW-S when: Strongcoat EPW-S is suitable for use in reservoirs
beats.vo: EPW-P: potable water. EPW-S: sewage, chemicals, oils and fuel.

beats.on: Joints and penetrations are where water finds a path.
beats.vo: Joints and penetrations are where water finds a path.

beats.on: Hydrostop HW · Hyperseal DP-2010H
beats.vo: Candidate products: Hydrostop HW, Hyperseal DP-2010H.

beats.on: Concrete on both sides of the joint | Hydrostop HW cast across the joint
beats.vo: A PVC waterstop is cast across the joint.

beats.on: should be tied by wire to the reinforcement through the eyelets in the edge flanges / Full range of factory made junction pieces are available for all profiles / Allow 24 hours for curing before pouring concrete on top of the joint
beats.vo: Tie waterstops to reinforcement; allow 24 hours after bonding before pouring.

beats.on: Comparison — different test methods
beats.vo: Different tests, so each product is shown as reported.

beats.on: Choose Hydrostop HW when: Hollow center bulb for expansion joints to accommodate / Choose Hyperseal DP-2010H when: Slow expansion rate to prevent damage to freshly
beats.vo: HW: hollow bulb for expansion joints. DP-2010H: not for expansion joints.

beats.on: Repcoat · Repcoat FF · Repcoat FF Plus · Repcoat S
beats.vo: Candidate products: Repcoat, Repcoat FF, Repcoat FF Plus, Repcoat S.

beats.on: Concrete surface | Repcoat Primer | Repcoat — per coat
beats.vo: Primer first, then Repcoat at the stated rate per coat.

beats.on: Two coats should always be used on dark, absorbent and heavily textured surfaces / It is important to wait for a minimum of 12 hours before the application of Repcoat / The first coat can be diluted by up to 15% with clean water depending on the surface porosity
beats.vo: Wait for the primer; two coats on dark, absorbent surfaces.

beats.on: Comparison — different test methods
beats.vo: Carbonation is tested differently, so no bars. Missing data is tagged.

beats.on: Choose Repcoat when: High build elastomeric, microporous coating. / Choose Repcoat FF when: Matt finish helping to hide irregularities.
beats.vo: Repcoat: high-build elastomeric. FF: matt finish.

beats.on: Strongcoat EN100 · Strongcoat EPW-S · Repcoat P
beats.vo: Candidate products: Strongcoat EN100, Strongcoat EPW-S, Repcoat P.

beats.on: Concrete or steel (grit-blasted) | Strongcoat EN100 base coat + topcoat
beats.vo: EN100: base coat and topcoat on prepared concrete or steel.

beats.on: Apply first coat of Strongcoat EN100 at a rate of 0.33 kg/m2 to achieve 250 micron thickness / Strongcoat EN100 is designed to be used without a primer. / Precaution is recommended if the application is taking place at high temperatures (above 30oC)
beats.vo: Base coat at the stated rate; no primer unless porous.

beats.on: Comparison
beats.vo: Bond strength uses the same method for all three.

beats.on: Choose Strongcoat EN100 when: Excellent chemical resistance. / Choose Repcoat P when: Excellent UV resistance.
beats.vo: EN100: chemical resistance. Repcoat P: UV resistance.
